articles.title: Bitcoin’s biggest quantum risk may not be wallet keys. An early investor fears something bigger
articles.snippet: Andrew Gault, the venture capitalist who funded the quantum hardware labs now threatening bitcoin, says the industry is looking in the wrong place. Google's own security team moved in the same direction in March.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s major holders halt buys as demand slows: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant says that the holding structure for large Bitcoin holders is deteriorating, a trend that has historically preceded “sustained price weakness.”
